alignment.exact_duplicate_control: identical complete-record multisets of observed chain sequences grouped regardless length
alignment.grouping: connected components of protein pairs with any qualifying chain pair
alignment.identity_denominator: aligned residue pairs, excluding gap columns
alignment.limitation: short proteins and fragmentary homologs can remain undetected; not all-family independence
alignment.sequence_source: observed first-model C-alpha residues, separately by chain
alignment.tie_policy: first optimal alignment returned by the pinned Biopython version
alignment.unknown_identity: X-X is not counted as an identity

annotations: legacy annotation columns do not establish residue identity; excluded from primary modeling
fold_policy: descending group residue count, seeded SHA256 tie order; least-loaded fold, numeric tie order

protocol_amendment.amended_rule: identity>=30%, coverage>=80% of each chain,>=50 aligned pairs; exact whole-record sequence duplicates also grouped
protocol_amendment.observed_failure: one connected component for all364 proteins, preventing five-fold grouped evaluation
protocol_amendment.original_rule: local alignment identity>=30%, coverage>=80% of shorter chain, any chain pair
protocol_amendment.timing: before fitting any prediction model; based only on observed sequences

structure_policy: first model; recognized protein C-alpha atoms; altloc highest occupancy then blank/A/lexical; duplicate coordinates excluded
subcohort_policy: nested 60 then20, equal protein-count length terciles, seeded SHA256 within tercile; force1ULR/1X3O
target: C-alpha B-factor standardized within the entire protein record, ddof=0; used as target only
